headline: CAC Holdings Corporation files substantial acquisition disclosure for Inspirisys Solutions under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: CAC Holdings Corporation has filed a Regulation 31(4)–31(5) disclosure with NSE for a substantial acquisition in Inspirisys Solutions Limited, signalling a material shareholding event triggering mandatory takeover code compliance.
detail: CAC Holdings Corporation, a foreign entity, has submitted a statutory disclosure under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE, evidencing a crossing of the 5% (or higher slab) disclosure threshold in Inspirisys Solutions Limited. The disclosure filing is a mandatory stepping-stone in India's takeover code framework: it freezes the acquirer's ability to acquire further shares until the public announcement is made and the open-offer window (if triggered) is navigated. The specific shareholding percentage, acquisition date and consideration remain to be confirmed from the full regulatory filing or company press release.
